name: Guest cannot write catalog [update-product]
description:
Write-side access control: can a user CHANGE something that isn't theirs, or do admin-only actions?

Safety on the shared site: probes that SHOULD be blocked use non-existent ids or empty bodies, so even
when the app is broken nothing real is created or modified. Confirmed app bugs are strict xfails.

statusMessage:
XFAIL BUG: catalog write endpoints don't require login; a guest gets 404/422 (input checked) instead of 401 (found 2026-11-10)

AssertionError: guest PUT /products/00000000000000000000000000 must require login: 404 {"message":"Requested item not found"}
assert 404 == 401
 +  where 404 = <Response [404]>.status_code
